integrity: The nefness and simple-normal-crossings strengthening is proved from the intersection geometry of Liu's construction. The bundled computation only regression-checks arithmetic identities and is not evidence for the general quantifier.
scientific_limitations: The divisors remain reducible; no prime or irreducible counterexample is claimed. The exact first moving multiple is not computed, only Liu's proved non-moving range. Simultaneous transversality uses a very general branch divisor over the uncountable field of complex numbers.
title: Nef and big non-movable divisors of fixed square \(4\) on one surface
